messages:
esther_cs: Heads up 1: Cobalt Labs submitted a request for a private 13B with strict PHI suppression, EU residency, and HSM-managed keys. They want a short safety pass before we hand to Dedicated.
noah_se: Quick compatibility check done. Model loads, kv-cache stable. We used int4 quant + fp16 cache per their accuracy ask. Artifacts at s3://redwood-private/cobalt/13b/v2.
dr_reyes_cobalt: Important: no outbound telemetry for pilot and customer-managed HSM key only. Also need a reproducible eval they can run onsite.
ivy_ml: Draft safety/eval plan: 1) PHI leakage probes (n=1500) 2) prompt-injection role tests (n=500) 3) regression vs cobalt baseline (n=800). Pass thresholds: PHI leaks <0.2%, fidelity > 93%.
owen_sec: Security note: HSM connector deployment requires their infra to grant connector role in VPC. We'll support no-token retention and redact token metadata. Will provide checklist and minimal network diagram.
esther_cs: Renewal note 1: Cobalt said pilot metrics directly affect year-1 committed capacity. If we miss latency or PHI thresholds, they may scale down. Flagging renewal-risk-high and looping AE.
dr_reyes_cobalt: Timeline: pilot starts Jun 1. We want the enablement session the week prior and the one-command eval runner now so our infra can vet it.
noah_se: Eval runner example (for reproducible runs):
```
./redwood_eval --endpoint https://private.redwood/cobalt-13b --suite cobalt_phi_suite.json --seed 2026 --out cobalt_report.json
```
ci-bot: artifact upload complete: s3://redwood-private/cobalt/13b/v2 (sha256: a3b9...)
owen_sec: Action items: I'll post the HSM deployment checklist + audit retention policy by EOD tomorrow. Need Cobalt infra sign-off.
ivy_ml: Action: I'll run the PHI probe suite and post initial summary + sample prompts in 48 hours.
esther_cs: I'll schedule a 60-min enablement + runbook review. @dr_reyes_cobalt please confirm Tue/Wed morning CET options.
dr_reyes_cobalt: Tue morning CET works. Also request: fallback behavior if private cluster is unavailable 1: legal wants an explicit fallback to hosted EU variant and an audit event recorded (no token details).
noah_se: We'll configure tenant policy with fallback to hosted-eu-13b and tenant-level audit events only. Config snippet:
```
{"tenant":"cobalt","deploy_mode":"private","region":"eu-west-1","hsm":true,"no_token_logging":true,"fallback":"hosted-eu-13b"}
```
esther_cs: Noted. I'll create the renewal-risk ticket in CRM and attach these action items. Keeping this thread as canonical onboarding tracker and enablement coordination. Thanks all :rocket:
